engine.warnings.W_NO_HOUR_PILLAR: Birth time is unknown: the hour pillar is omitted and confidence is reduced. Luck starts are estimated from local noon, with uncertainty of approximately one year.
engine.warnings.W_NOON_CHART: Birth time is unknown. The chart uses local noon without houses or angles.
engine.warnings.W_GENDER_DEFAULTED: Gender was not specified; luck-cycle direction uses the male convention.
engine.warnings.W_SUSPECTED_CONG: The chart is very weak and rootless; a possible following pattern is flagged for reference.
bazi.rules.support: A weak Day Master favors resource and peer elements.
bazi.rules.drain: A strong Day Master favors authority, output and wealth elements.
bazi.rules.balance: A balanced Day Master prioritizes seasonal temperature balance.
bazi.rules.tiao_hou_fire: Little fire in winter calls for a fire temperature-balance tag.
bazi.rules.tiao_hou_water: Little water in summer calls for a water temperature-balance tag.
bazi.rules.no_transformation: This method retains the original stem elements without combination transformation.
bazi.rules.suspected_cong: Extreme weakness without roots suggests a possible following pattern; no detailed determination is made.
engine.errors.E_ENGINE_INTERNAL: Chart integrity validation failed. Please try again later.
engine.warnings.W_HOUSE_SYSTEM_FALLBACK: The latitude exceeds 66°. Placidus houses have fallen back to Whole Sign.
engine.astrology.chironApproximate: Chiron uses a simplified orbit; its position is approximate.
engine.astrology.moonUncertainty: With an unknown birth time, the Moon longitude has approximately ±6° uncertainty.
engine.vedic.nakshatraUncertainty: With an unknown birth time, the Moon may cross adjacent Nakshatras during the day.

charts.noHouses: Rising sign and houses require a birth time.

charts.vedic.northNeedsTime: The North Indian fixed-house chart requires a birth time. Use the South Indian fixed-sign chart.
charts.vedic.southLegend: Signs are fixed; a diagonal marks the Lagna cell.
charts.vedic.northLegend: Houses are fixed; house 1 is upper center. Numbers identify signs (1 = Aries).
charts.vedic.noon: Noon chart: calculated at local 12:00 because birth time is unknown. Lagna and houses are unavailable; D9 and Dasha are provisional.
charts.vedic.noonMansion: Nakshatra and Pada reflect the noon position and may change with the actual birth time.
charts.vedic.noonDasha: Without a birth time, period dates are noon estimates. No current Mahadasha or Antardasha is identified.
